name: File Viewer
description: Read a file directly and return its content with line numbers. Best for inspecting code files.

file_path.description: Relative path from workspace root or absolute path of the file to view.

start_line.description: The line number to start viewing from (1-indexed). Default is 1.

end_line.description: The line number to end viewing (inclusive, 1-indexed). Default is start_line + 200.
